note: Sargent County park on Silver Lake ~6 mi south of Forman. The main RV area fills a peninsula, its west-shore row at the water's edge; more sites sit in wooded loops on the west side. Beaches, boat landings and playgrounds on both the north and south shores, disc golf, volleyball and ATV trails. --Claude
summary: County page confirms $25 RV / $15 primitive RV / $10 tent (weekly/monthly too), 86 sites (55 electric+water, 14 seasonal, 17+ primitive), showers, FCFS only, May 1-Oct 1; 14-day limit from the park regulations. Amps unpublished. Lakefront kept physically (peninsula west-shore row), but the county publishes no site numbers.
flags: WATERFRONT (lakefront, check): kept, with a gap. Imagery: the main RV area is a ~110-130 m-wide peninsula into Silver Lake around 46.0243,-97.5735. Its west-shore row of RVs (about a dozen units from ~46.0228,-97.5752 north to ~46.0250,-97.5740) is parked between the camp road and the water on open grass, ~10-25 m from the shoreline; units on the north tip (~46.0257,-97.5725) are ~20 m from the water; the east shore of the peninsula is behind a continuous conifer band. The county publishes no site numbers or map, so the shoreline pads cannot be named or shown to be nightly rather than among the 14 seasonal lots (the seasonal-lease rules allow decks, carports and sheds, and several north-tip units carry them). 72 of the 86 sites are not seasonal, so most of a dozen-unit shoreline row should sell by the night, but that is inference. The west-side wooded loops (~46.0236,-97.5770) sit behind a tree band on a marsh channel (view at best); the north-shore area (~46.0265,-97.5700) is cabins/sheds by the shop building, not the campground. Reviewer: lakefront stays on the peninsula row unless a site list shows it is seasonal.
LONG-STAY: 14 seasonal lots of 86 ($950 a season in 2018; lease rules on the county page); nightly $25 RV posted; FCFS public park; 14-day limit on non-seasonal sites. Passes; not mostly seasonal.

BASE RATE: $25 is the plain RV site; the county also prices a primitive area at $15 for RVs (kept in fees.note, not as the base, under the brief's no-primitive base rule). Reviewer may prefer nightly_low 15.
DUMP: the stored entry had no dump; the county names only '3 RV/trailer portable disposal services' (a portable/honey-wagon service, not a fixed station), so dump is left unset.
